title: codiaeum johannis
intro: Codiaeum johannis, commonly known as the Ceylon croton or red croton, is a tropical evergreen shrub native to Sri Lanka and southern India. This plant is known for its vibrant red and green foliage, which is often used in traditional medicine and as an ornamental plant. The health benefits of Codiaeum johannis include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Codiaeum johannis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
